subject: Re: Probe dataset transfer & evaluation MAP — timeline and constraints
messages:

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Probe dataset ready for exchange — MAP & constraints?

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood team’s latency profile looks promising for our ingestion pipeline. We have a small set of annotated probe testcases (about 120 files, ~2GB compressed) we can share under a short mutual action plan so your eval team can run a focused quality baseline.

Before we send, two asks from our side:
- We need a MAP that records scope (files, labels, timebox), allowed usage (no external redistribution; ephemeral sandbox), and destruction date.
- We require Redwood to confirm retention and access controls (SOC2 scope + audit logging) for the sandbox.

Goal: 2-week evaluation with a decision point (procurement or stop) at the end. Can you share a draft MAP and the ingestion instructions so we can stage the transfer? We can put the files on an s3 bucket and share creds once the MAP is agreed.

Attachments: ICX_probe_testcases_v1.zip (preview manifest attached)

—Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of ML Evaluation, ICX Therapeutics

Subject: Re: Probe dataset ready for exchange — MAP & constraints?

Hi Sanjay — really appreciate the quick turnaround.

We’re happy to proceed. Draft plan from Redwood:
- Step 1 (Day 0–2): Sign mutual action plan (MAP) + Redwood standard MPA addendum for ephemeral evals.
- Step 2 (Day 2–4): Secure transfer — ICX uploads to a presigned s3 bucket; Redwood confirms checksum and ingest instructions.
- Step 3 (Week 1): Redwood runs baseline evals (quality, distribution checks, edge-case pass/fail).
- Step 4 (Week 2): Joint review, retention confirmation, and either convert to trial credits/PO or schedule secure destruction.

We’ll attach a draft MAP and our ingest guide for quick review. A few notes up front:
- We can commit to a 14-day ephemeral sandbox with guaranteed deletion and a snapshot audit log.
- We respect the no-redistribution constraint — we’ll include that clause in the MAP and in access provisioning.
- We will need ICX to confirm which internal Redwood users should get access and to provide the PO/commit timing if you want to convert the trial into a Dedicated/hosted contract.

Proposed next steps:
1) ICX reviews the attached MAP-Redwood-ICX-draft.docx and returns redlines.
2) We do a 30-minute kickoff to confirm files and retention policy.
3) Transfer on agreed presigned link.

I’ve looped in Marissa for the security checklist and Ben for commercial.

Attachments: MAP-Redwood-ICX-draft.docx; sample_ingest_instructions.md

Best,
Naomi

Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Hi all — quick security / ops checklist to keep the exchange moving:

Minimum items we need from ICX before ingest:
- Confirmation that data contains no PHI or any regulated patient identifiers (explicit statement).
- A short manifest listing files, formats, and label taxonomy (CSV).
- Desired retention window (we recommend 14 days for ephemeral evals).
- Point of contact for incident response and a technical contact for ingestion (for presigned URL expiry windows).

On Redwood’s side:
- We’ll enable per-user RBAC for the sandbox; access will be tokenized and time-limited.
- Audit logs and access traces will be exported to a sealed log store for the duration of the eval; we can share redacted logs on request.
- We can run the baseline suite using the redwood-eval-qa-guidelines.pdf and return the report as a Google Drive link.

If ICX can confirm the non-PHI statement and send the CSV manifest, we’ll provision the bucket and share the presigned URL.

Thanks — happy to do a 15-min sync once the MAP is returned with redlines.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security & Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 11:07:00 -0700

Sanjay / Emma — quick commercial note so expectations are aligned:
- Redwood can offer a 14-day evaluation with a $2,000 platform credit applied to the first invoice if ICX signs within 30 days of the trial end.
- If ICX prefers an extended pilot (30 days), we can expand the window but we’d ask for a minimal PO commitment to reserve Dedicated slots.
- Any work to instrument custom metrics or heavy reprocessing outside the baseline suite would be scoped and estimated separately.

If that sounds ok, we’ll bake the credit/offer into the MAP Annex A so it’s visible to procurement.

—Ben
